d: The apical follicular-cell enzyme that oxidizes iodide, attaches it to tyrosines on thyroglobulin and couples the iodotyrosines; thionamides block it.
The basolateral transporter that concentrates iodide in the follicular cell using the sodium gradient; perchlorate and pertechnetate compete for it.
The liver protein that carries most circulating T4; estrogen raises it, so total T4 rises while free T4 stays normal.
